# HEPE Governance Document Instructions
- Conversation, AI output, Copilot Memory and Copilot comments are not Audit Evidence by themselves.
- Clearly distinguish PROPOSED, APPROVED, FROZEN/CONTROLLED, VERIFIED and UNVERIFIED states.
- Do not silently rewrite historical evidence or convert a proposal to a baseline without provenance and authority.
- Evidence admission requires Evidence ID, Evidence Type, Source, Version/Date, Authority/Owner, Relevant Contract/Assertion and Verification Status; tests additionally require Expected and Actual results.
- Controlled Baseline / Verified Evidence overrides conflicting discussion or AI summary; record a Finding/Reconciliation Item instead of silently changing the baseline.
- NON-PRODUCTION governance approval is not Production Authorization.
